scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter create-dshx typecheck && pnpm --filter create-dshx test && pnpm --filter create-dshx build
scripts.check:all: pnpm run check && pnpm run hub:check && pnpm run smoke:rc2
scripts.hub:check: pnpm --filter @becomeopc/dshx-framework-hub typecheck && pnpm --filter @becomeopc/dshx-framework-hub lint && pnpm --filter @becomeopc/dshx-framework-hub test && pnpm --filter @becomeopc/dshx-framework-hub build && pnpm --filter @becomeopc/dshx-hub-cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @becomeopc/dshx-hub-cli lint && pnpm --filter @becomeopc/dshx-hub-cli test && pnpm --filter @becomeopc/dshx-hub-cli build
scripts.hub:deploy: pnpm run check:all && pnpm --filter @becomeopc/dshx-framework-hub db:migrate:remote && pnpm --filter @becomeopc/dshx-framework-hub deploy:worker && node scripts/smoke-hub.mjs https://dshx.io
